declarations.name: BxDataTable
declarations.description:
`<bx-data-table>` — virtualized enterprise data table (docs/features/data-table/data-table.md),
built on core's `VirtualizerController`. Only the visible rows *and* columns (past 50 columns)
exist in the DOM; cell renderers are plain functions returning templates or primitives, so there
is no custom element per cell.

**Data pipeline.** `data` (client) flows through filter → sort → group on *index arrays* — rows
are never copied. Sort keys are extracted once per column into typed arrays, and the sort is
stable. Grouping adds expandable group rows with per-column aggregates. With `data-source` the
table is server-side: a block cache (100 rows/block) fetches only the blocks near the viewport,
de-duplicates in-flight requests, aborts blocks that scrolled away, and a failed block shows a
retry row (`bx-data-error`).

**Grid semantics.** `role="grid"` with `aria-rowcount/rowindex/colcount/colindex/sort/selected`
derived from data indexes, so rows scrolled out of the DOM keep their numbers. One cell holds
the roving `tabindex`; arrows, Home/End, Ctrl+Home/End and PageUp/PageDown move it; the header
row is part of the grid (Enter/Space sorts, Alt+Arrow resizes, Alt+Shift+Arrow reorders). Space
selects the row, Shift+Arrow extends a cell range, Ctrl/Cmd+C copies the range as TSV. A polite
live region announces sort, selection and edit results.

**Editing.** With `editable` and a column `editor` (`text`, `number`, `checkbox`, `select` or a
function), Enter/F2/double-click edits, Enter commits, Escape cancels, Tab commits and moves.
`bx-cell-edit-commit` is cancelable and supports async validation: call
`event.detail.waitUntil(promise)`; a rejected promise (or `false`) keeps the editor open with an
error. An accepted edit assigns `row[field]` (data is held as provided, not cloned).

**Layout.** Columns come from `columns` or declarative `<bx-column>` children. Pinned columns are
`position: sticky`. `responsive="priority"` hides the least important columns (`priority`) as
the table's own width shrinks; `"cards"` re-lays each row as a labelled card below
`cards-breakpoint` px; `"scroll"` scrolls horizontally. The width is observed through the shared
`ResizeObserver` pool, so the table is its own container, not a viewport.

Gaps, per docs/features/_conventions.md's "say so inline" rule: sorting/filtering/grouping run on
the main thread (no Worker; the pipeline is index-based and typed-array backed to keep it cheap
— see the performance note in the spec's acceptance list); tree-data mode, the column show/hide
*menu UI* (use `setColumnVisible()`), drag-to-pin UI (use `setColumnPinned()`), the toolbar
overflow menu and the `columns` serialization of renderers are not implemented; `row-detail` is
the `renderDetail` property; the built-in editors are native `<input>`/`<select>` (use a function
`editor` to render `bx-input`/`bx-select`); server-side mode does not group (`group` is passed to the source).
`exportXlsx()` writes a single-sheet, uncompressed (stored) workbook.

members.name: retry
members.description: Retries blocks that failed to load.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Reloads server data or recomputes the client view.

members.name: invalidateRow
members.description: The data changed in place for this row: recompute its view and size.

members.name: selectAll
members.description: Selects every row matching the current filter (server mode: "select all matching").

members.name: exportCsv
members.description: CSV of the rows in the current sort/filter. Resolves to a Blob; pass a name to download it.

members.name: exportXlsx
members.description: Single-sheet `.xlsx` of the rows in the current sort/filter.

members.name: autosizeColumns
members.description: Widths each column to its widest rendered text among the rows near the viewport.

members.name: getState
members.description: Serializable layout/sort/filter state for saved views (renderers are not included).

events.name: bx-cell-edit-commit
events.description: Cancelable; `detail: { row, key, columnId, oldValue, newValue, waitUntil(promise) }`.

events.name: bx-data-request
events.description: A server block was requested. `detail: { start, end }`.

events.name: bx-data-error
events.description: A server block failed. `detail: { error, block }`.

events.name: bx-row-expand
events.description: A group or detail row was toggled. `detail: { key, expanded }`.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Shown when there are no rows.

cssParts.name: cell-selected
cssParts.description: A cell in the selected range.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-row-height
cssProperties.description: Row height (density default).

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-header-height
cssProperties.description: Header height.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-stripe
cssProperties.description: Background of odd rows.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-border
cssProperties.description: Border color.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-cell-padding-inline
cssProperties.description: Cell inline padding.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-fg
cssProperties.description: Text/icon color of the root surface. Default `var(--bx-text-primary)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-min-height
cssProperties.description: Minimum height of the root surface. Default `calc(var(--bx-unit) * 10)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-scroller-border-width
cssProperties.description: Border width of the `scroller` element. Default `var(--bx-border-width)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-scroller-radius
cssProperties.description: Corner radius of the `scroller` element. Default `var(--bx-radius-m)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-scroller-bg
cssProperties.description: Background of the `scroller` element. Default `var(--bx-surface-base)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-header-bg
cssProperties.description: Background of the `header` part. Default `var(--bx-surface-subtle)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-header-block-end-border-width
cssProperties.description: Block end border width of the `header` part. Default `var(--bx-border-width)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-header-cell-gap
cssProperties.description: Gap of the `header-cell` part. Default `var(--bx-space-xs)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-sort-fg
cssProperties.description: Text/icon color of the `sort` element. Default `var(--bx-text-secondary)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-sort-font-size
cssProperties.description: Font size of the `sort` element. Default `0.8em`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-resize-handle-width
cssProperties.description: Width of the `resize-handle` part. Default `calc(var(--bx-unit) * 0.5)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-resize-handle-hover-bg
cssProperties.description: Background of the `resize-handle` part (hover state). Default `var(--bx-role-accent)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-header-cell-pinned-bg
cssProperties.description: Background of the `header-cell` part (pinned state). Default `var(--bx-surface-base)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-header-cell-pinned-shadow
cssProperties.description: Box shadow of the `header-cell` part (pinned state). Default `inset calc(var(--bx-border-width) * -1) 0 0 var(--bx-border-subtle)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-header-cell-focus-ring-width
cssProperties.description: Focus ring width of the `header-cell` part (focus state). Default `var(--bx-border-width-strong)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-header-cell-focus-ring-color
cssProperties.description: Focus ring color of the `header-cell` part (focus state). Default `var(--bx-focus-ring)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-header-cell-focus-ring-offset
cssProperties.description: Focus ring offset of the `header-cell` part (focus state). Default `calc(var(--bx-focus-ring-offset) * -1)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-group-row-block-end-border-width
cssProperties.description: Block end border width of the `group-row` part. Default `var(--bx-border-width)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-group-row-bg
cssProperties.description: Background of the `group-row` part. Default `var(--bx-surface-base)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-group-row-hover-bg
cssProperties.description: Background of the `group-row` part (hover state). Default `var(--bx-surface-subtle)`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-group-row-selected-bg
cssProperties.description: Background of the `group-row` part (selected state). Default `color-mix( in srgb, var(--bx-role-accent) 14%, var(--bx-surface-base) )`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-cell-bg
cssProperties.description: Background of the `cell` part. Default `color-mix( in srgb, var(--bx-role-accent) 20%, var(--bx-surface-base) )`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-skeleton-height
cssProperties.description: Height of the `skeleton` element. Default `0.8em`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-skeleton-bg
cssProperties.description: Background of the `skeleton` element. Default `var(--bx-surface-muted, var(--bx-surface-subtle))`.

cssProperties.name: --bx-data-table-input-padding
cssProperties.description: Padding of the `input` element. Default `0.15em 0.3em`.
